title: Lease Term Bonus on the Courtesy Waiver Share
content:
An Apartment Home Lease whose current Lease Term Agreement runs 13 months or longer adds 0.10 to the courtesy waiver share, one whose current term runs 10 to 12 months adds 0.05, and any shorter current term adds nothing.

**Record read.** The term length in months of the customer's Lease Term Agreement that is in current status for the lease. A lease with no current Lease Term Agreement on record adds nothing.

**Effect on the share.** The bonus is added to the waiver share before the share is applied to the covered late fees, and the waiver share never exceeds the whole.

## Bonus schedule

| Current Lease Term Agreement length | Bonus added to the waiver share |
|---|---|
| 13 months or longer (for example an Extended Lease of 13-15 months or a Long-Term Lease of 16-24 months) | 0.10 |
| 10 to 12 months | 0.05 |
| 9 months or shorter | nothing |

**Boundaries.** A 12-month term adds 0.05 and a 13-month term adds 0.10; a 9-month term adds nothing and a 10-month term adds 0.05.

## Hypothetical effects

| Waiver share before the bonus | Current term | Share applied |
|---|---|---|
| 0.60 | 14 months | 0.70 |
| 0.80 | 12 months | 0.85 |
| 0.80 | 6 months | 0.80 |
| the whole (1) | 13 months | the whole (1), never more |
